The '''''Galax Titan''''' was an [[X46-7-Class Ore Carrier]] that operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].
